intro: Small puzzles whose rules come from real quantum effects: superposition, measurement and interference. Each game page says which rules follow the physics and which are conventions of the game, so playing well and understanding the effect go together.

games.title: Quantum 2028
games.summary: Slide numbered tiles and merge equal ones, but a merged tile lands in both of its cells at once, as two identical photons do at a beam splitter. Observe it to find out where it is, rejoin its halves to place it yourself, and use tiles of opposite sign to cancel each other.
